sloka: इच्छामि त्वां समानेतुमद्यैव रघुबन्धुना ।गुरुस्नेहेन भक्त्या च नान्यथैतदुदाहृतम् ।। ५.३८.९।।।।
transliteration: icchāmi tvāṁ samānetumadyaiva raghubandhunā ।gurusnehena bhaktyā ca nānyathaitadudāhṛtam ।। 5.38.9।।।।

translations.english: "I offered to take you today itself out of my love and devotion to Rama with a desire to unite you with him and not with any other intention.
